journey.name: wear quickpay skips hold
journey.description:
With QuickPay on in the phone's settings, an invoice under the phone's QuickPay amount is paid without the review and without the hold: the link goes straight to sending and the same "Sent" check, and the flow closes by itself. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Phone settings on VSS, see journeys/wear/README.md › Phone settings on VSS, with QuickPay on at $1 and the daily limit at 5× on the phone, and the phone app closed. Then Restored wallet on the watch with the same recovery phrase on the local ./spark stack with at least 2 000 sats (run receive-paid.xml first), see README › Local ./spark stack, with the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. The watch reads the phone's settings from the hosted staging VSS whatever Spark network it is on. 200 sats are under $1 while a bitcoin costs less than $500 000.

actions.action: Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Verify "WatchSettingsSyncTime" reads a time of at most 5 minutes ago; if it does not, tap "WatchSettingsSync" and wait 10 s
Swipe right three times to the Balance page and wait until "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads a fiat value, for up to 1 minute: QuickPay needs the rates
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 200` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 20 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed, touching nothing
Verify `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Skipped the hold to pay under QuickPay"
Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
